title: DEV CASE: two identical 12 h training jobs died at the wall and the loop paused itself
symptom: Job 44727703 hit the walltime at epoch 24 of 60 and was recorded TIMEOUT; the next tick resubmitted the identical command, which failed at epoch 16; two failures tripped the stop-loss.
root_cause: The merged pool had grown to 8,583 iterations per epoch, so 60 epochs needed about 29 hours against a 12 hour walltime. No projection was computed in flight and the only metric writer ran at the end, so everything the jobs knew died with them.
correction_made: v3.25.0: an Ultralytics time= cap at 0.9x walltime so a run stops on time with a valid best.pt; an append-only hash-chained per-epoch trace written as the job goes; a job-scoped run directory and artifact read by job id; a review state machine that holds a failed step instead of resubmitting, with a bounded walltime-shaped-only fallback correction (halve the epochs, never below a floor, recorded as {old,new,reason,from_round,review_id}).
